title: Device
description: Represents a connected device registered with an IoT platform, including identity, metadata, connection state, and the reported and desired shadow state.

device_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the device, often the platform-issued thing name or device ID.

device_type.description: Type or category of the device.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer or brand of the device.

model.description: Model identifier reported by the device.

firmware_version.description: Firmware version currently running on the device.

protocol.description: Primary transport protocol the device uses to communicate with the platform.

connection_status.description: Current connection state of the device.

last_seen.description: Timestamp the platform last received a message or heartbeat from the device.

location.description: Optional geographic or logical location of the device.

shadow.description: Device shadow capturing reported and desired state for the device.

reported.description: State most recently reported by the device.

desired.description: State the platform wants the device to converge to.

tags.description: User or platform tags applied to the device.
